name: CCH versus surgery
question: How do collagenase Clostridium histolyticum and penile surgery compare for men with Peyronie's disease when both include RestoreX traction and sildenafil?

design.blinding: Patients and surgeon unblinded; objective assessor blinded to baseline measurements

arms.label: collagenase Clostridium histolyticum plus RestoreX traction and sildenafil
penile plication or incision and grafting plus RestoreX traction and sildenafil

design.population: Forty men with Peyronie's disease, at least 30 degrees of curvature, and erections adequate for intercourse with or without phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitors were randomized.
design.locator: Full text, Methods: Study Design and Randomization, Eligibility Criteria; Results, Table 1

verdictNote: Three subjective primary comparisons favored CCH; satisfaction and IIEF-EFD were not significant.
takeaway: In 40 randomized men with Peyronie's disease, collagenase Clostridium histolyticum versus surgery, each with RestoreX traction and sildenafil, produced less objective curvature correction but better patient-reported length and sensation at three months; very satisfied responses did not differ significantly.

delivery.label: CCH injection and modeling
delivery.value: Two 0.9-mg CCH injections diluted to 0.8 mL, one day apart, with office modeling on day 2; up to four series and home modeling.

delivery.label: Surgical procedures
delivery.value: 18/19 plications and 1/19 plaque incision and grafting; six additional extratunical grafts.
delivery.locator: Full text, Results; Discussion, paragraph on hourglass and indentation

delivery.label: Plication and graft technique
delivery.value: Permanent 2-0 Ethibond plication sutures were buried after partial-thickness tunical incisions; incision graft used autologous tunica vaginalis, extratunical grafts TachoSil.

delivery.label: RestoreX use
delivery.note: Prescribed use was 30-60 minutes/day; P = 0.02 between arms.
